notes.title: Update Cross-Platform and Gameplay improvements
notes.notes:
A new update has just been released, bringing exciting changes and improvements to VR Tribes! Here’s what’s new: 

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved „default“ balancing across all maps. 
[*] Customizable gameplay settings: The VR player can now adjust settings like:
[list]
[*] Health for Meteor (VR) and Tribes (PC)
[*] Ammo for the VR player’s gun
[*] Power of the laser eyes 
[/list]
[*] Exploding platforms: Most maps now include platforms that explode when reached by a Tribe player. 
[*] Redesigned the “Meteor’s Galaxy” map for a better experience. 
[*] Fixed various bugs (UI and gameplay) 
[*] Groht’s walls now auto-destroy after a certain time. 
[*] Adjusted Maka’s clone behavior for more confusion. 
[*] Made Bay’s hiding ability more noticeable for the VR player. 
[*] Groht’s weight increased: The impact from thrown meteors is now less effective on Groht compared to other Tribes. 
[/list]

[b]Cross Platform[/b]
[list]
[*] Epic Online Services (EOS) is now implemented, enabling seamless cross-platform play. 
[*] VR Tribes is soon a standalone experience on Meta Quest 2 and 3. 
[*] Play together across Steam (PC), Android (tablet, phone), and Meta Quest. 
[*] iOS support is coming soon! 
[/list]

[b]Graphics[/b]
Optimized graphics-intensive shaders to provide a similar visual quality to the standalone Meta Quest version. 

[b]Privacy Update[/b]
VR Tribes now uses Epic Online Services (EOS) to enable cross-platform multiplayer functionality on platforms like Steam, Android, Meta Quest, and iOS.
You don’t need an Epic Games account, as VR Tribes will use either your active account (e.g., Steam, Meta) or your device ID. Through EOS, we provide a cross-platform login system.

What data is processed? 
[list]
[*] Personal data such as your username, account information, and online status is collected and processed by Epic Games, Inc. to enable these services. 
[*] If required, data may be shared with authorities to comply with legal obligations. 
[*] Your data may be stored and processed outside the EU, including in the USA.
[/list]
For more details, please visit our Privacy Policy & EULA:
https://framelocker.games/privacy-policy-eula-vr-tribes/
By using our game, you consent to the processing of your personal data as outlined above. 

Thank you for your continued support! We look forward to hearing your feedback and seeing you in-game.
The VR Tribes Team

notes.title: VR TRIBES goes mobile
notes.notes:
The time has come, the public test / beta phase for VR Tribes on mobile Android devices starts. Enjoy your epic battles locally in your living room or on your balcony! 

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.framelocker.VRTRIBES&pcampaignid=web_share]Download VR Tribes[/url]

The touch controllers are a bit more difficult to use on some devices, we are still working on that. It's best if you use a Bluetooth controller. 

To start and find a session over the local wireless lan please join our discord for more informations.

The implementation for iOS will follow in September! 

If you encounter any problems, just join our Discord server where we can fix problems faster! 

Have fun and all the best 
your VR TRIBES team

On top of that, we'll add a DLC with the full edition (pc and vr) for the previous price.

Things are moving forward. Happy gaming and all the best[/h3]

notes.title: Updated Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hey dear VR and PC players, 

after our first soft launch as early access on Steam we got a lot of feedback what players want from VR TRIBES. And of course we want to react to that.

After several night shifts and a long weekend of testing and discussing, we can announce that VR TRIBES is [b]becoming more accessible to all[/b].

In the coming weeks and until the final release we try to realize the following points: [i](in order of priority)[/i]

[b]1) PC only version [/b]
A "PC only version" on Steam so you can play with your non VR friends. We are considering offering this as a free application. We'd like to hear your opinion on whether you think this is fair?  


[b]2) Mobile Release pt 1 [/b]
The release in the Google Playstore for Android phones and tablets. It will be possible to play against the VR player in the local(!) network at home on mobile devices. 


[b]3) Quest 2 Standalone [/b]
The release on the Meta Quest 2 as a standalone application. Since we have focused a lot on designing graphically appealing levels, this is a major step to optimize the whole game to run smoothly on the Quest 2. Spoiler: the menu levels run smoothly at 72fps, the game maps between 40 and 55fps, so yes, we are already working on that as well. We can't promise anything at this point, but we will keep you updated on the development process. 

[i]So after steps 2 and 3, it will be possible to play against each other on the local(!) network on the Quest 2 standalone against Android phone or tablet in your living room (or even kitchen or bathroom...)![/i]


[b]4) Mobile Release pt 2 [/b]
Publishing on Apple mobile devices, so that they can play in the local network as well.


[b]5) Cross Platform [/b]
Up until this point, only Steam users have been able to truly compete online against the rest of the world. If demand is high, we will also be able to connect online across all platforms. For this, however, you as a player will need an Epic Games account to link your Steam, Google, Meta, or iOS account to. We'll have to see if that's worth it and if you as a player would do that.


[b]6) Adding new content [/b]
Constantly releasing new minimaps, designed according to your feedback and wishes!
